item.title: 现在流行这样的说法： “编码已解决” “我们不需要再关心源代码了” “代理可以生成机器代
item.description:
现在流行这样的说法：

“编码已解决”

“我们不需要再关心源代码了”

“代理可以生成机器代码”

说这种话的人，脑子还不够大。

我的吐槽：

It's become fashionable to say:

"coding is solved"

"we don't need to care about the source code anymore"

"agents can just generate machine code"

The people who say this, aren't thinking big enough.

My rant:

item.description:
https://x.com/jeremyphoward/status/2124697969547182326

@jeremyphoward

我同意。

我认为“软件已解决”阵营中的许多人都不够大胆。

如果你尝试做一些非常非常困难的事情，远远超出该领域任何人以前所取得的成就，你会清楚地看到局限性和机会。

I agree.

I think a lot of the folks in the "software is solved" camp aren't being bold enough.

If you try to do something really really difficult, well beyond what anyone has previously achieved in the field, you'll see the limitations and opportunities clearly.

item.description:

However, his blessed holy mother Mary never abandoned him.

item.title: Schevana v1 已发布。 在Schevana V0中，一切都是由Cairo绘制的。 现在，在 V1 中，一
item.description:
Schevana v1 已发布。

在Schevana V0中，一切都是由Cairo绘制的。
现在，在 V1 中，一切都是通过 GPU 绘制的......
着色器用Scheme编写并编译为GPU代码。

现在有一个 Boids 3D 演示，可以轻松处理多达 5000 只鸟。
在该演示中，一切都在 GPU 上运行（计算和图形）。

Boids 2D 也已更新，效率更高。
它还可以容纳多达 5000 只鸟。

我在 Ubuntu 26.04 上测试过。那里运行得很好。

https://github.com/paveluv/Schevana/releases/tag/v1

Schevana v1 has been released.

In Schevana V0, everything was drawn by Cairo.
Now, in V1, everything is drawn via GPU...
Shaders are written in Scheme and compiled to GPU code.

There's a now a Boids 3D demo which can easily handle up to 5000 birds.
In that demo, everything runs on the GPU (calculations and graphics).

Boids 2D has also been updated to be far more efficient.
It can also handle up to 5000 birds.

I tested it on Ubuntu 26.04. Runs great there.

https://github.com/paveluv/Schevana/releases/tag/v1
